Careers at BQR

We build the software that tells engineers what will fail, and why, before it does.

BQR has been working on reliability engineering for over three decades, for teams building hardware in aerospace, defence, medical, rail, energy and automotive. It is a small enough company that what you build is used, and specialised enough that you will learn something you cannot pick up elsewhere.
